subject: MAP-driven ramp, credit valuation & conversion timing
messages:
From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@clarityai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ClarityAI Procurement <procurement@clarityai.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP outline and close window

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profiles and cost breakdown were helpful. Our leadership wants a short mutual action plan we can take into procurement. Two quick asks from my side:

1) Can Redwood commit to a two-week pilot extension (to Dec 31) if we hit the MAP milestone for integration and eval?
2) We need a high-level pricing ladder for conversion: committed tier, expected ramp, and a one-time credit that flows into the first invoice.

I'm attaching the MAP template our CTO prefers and a procurement checklist. We need to present something to finance on 12/17 to keep the Q1 contract timeline.

Appreciate a quick sketch we can share.

Best,
Emma
VP Product, ClarityAI
[attachment: MAP_template.xlsx]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@clarityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP outline and close window

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can structure a MAP that ties an extension and a credit bucket to concrete milestones, and outline conversion pricing that steps down as you ramp committed throughput. High level proposal below (will attach a formal MAP and SOW in follow-up):

- MAP duration: 6 weeks (integration + eval + quantitative quality gate)
- Pilot extension: +2 weeks (to Dec 31) if integration milestone (data in, inference end-to-end) is met by 12/18
- Credit bucket: $60k one-time pilot credit that applies to invoice 1 upon conversion. Unused portion credited as a pro-rated discount within 60 days of conversion.
- Conversion pricing (starter tiers):
  * Commit A: 200M tokens/month — $0.006/token with quantization guidance and caching profile (3% discount on usage)
  * Commit B: 500M tokens/month — $0.005/token + 15% committed discount on invoice
  * Ramp support: 8 weeks of prioritized onboarding / dedicated capacity for first 30 days post-conversion

Next steps I propose: Ben will attach a draft SOW and a MAP spreadsheet with milestone dates and acceptance criteria. If Clarity can confirm the integration owners and procurement timeline by 12/10, we can meet your 12/17 finance review.

- Evelyn
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_ClarityAI_v2.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@clarityai.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: SOW + sample pricing schedule attached

Emma — attaching a short SOW and a pricing schedule that maps to Evelyn's tiers. A few operational notes:

- SOW includes acceptance test (90% parity on sample prompts + latency within 20th percentile of demo)
- If we hit integration milestone early, pilot credit can be partially applied to infra costs during the pilot (subject to SOW clause 4.2)
- Legal: we'll need procurement to sign our standard MSA with the negotiated committed tiers; if Clarity has a redline, please send before 12/14 so we can loop legal.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOW_ClarityAI_draft.pdf][attachment: pricing_schedule_v3.xlsx]

From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@clarityai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ClarityAI Procurement <procurement@clarityai.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOW + sample pricing schedule attached

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A couple clarifying questions before procurement presents to finance:

- Can the pilot credit be split (e.g., $40k infra, $20k conversion credit) or does it need to be a single invoice-level credit?
- For the convert price: does the committed tier pricing apply from day 1 of the first paid invoice, or do we get a 30-day smoothing period while traffic ramps?

Procurement asked if Redwood can give a 14-day guarantee to hold the quoted tiers (Commits A/B) while we finish procurement. They also asked for one sample redline of the MSA to speed review.

If you can confirm the split and smoothing within 24 hours, we can include the proposal in the 12/17 finance packet.

Best,
Emma
VP Product, ClarityAI

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@clarityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, ClarityAI Procurement <procurement@clarityai.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOW + sample pricing schedule attached

Emma / procurement team — confirming the final positions so procurement can present a clean one-pager to finance on 12/17. See the MAP snapshot below and attached SOW for acceptance criteria and DocuSign link.

MAP snapshot (final):
- MAP owner: ClarityAI (integration lead: Jason Lin)
- Milestone 1 (Integration): data pipeline and inference endpoint live; test harness runs — due 2026-12-18
- Milestone 2 (Eval): 2-week evaluation window with defined prompts and metrics — due 2026-12-31
- Acceptance gate: 90% quality parity on eval prompts OR agreed exception with product team

Commercial terms (final):
- Pilot extension: granted to 2026-12-31 conditional on Milestone 1 completion by 12/18
- Credit bucket: $60,000 total, split permitted — $40,000 infra credit (applies during pilot) + $20,000 conversion credit (applied to invoice 1 on conversion)
- Conversion pricing: committed tiers locked for 14 days from receipt of signed SOW/MSA; committed pricing effective on first paid invoice with 30-day ramp smoothing (usage billed at blended rate if ramp less than 30 days)
- Ramp support: 8 weeks of prioritized capacity and 30 days of free diagnostics and tuning included in SOW

Next steps:
1) Clarity: confirm integration lead and procurement reviewer by EOD 12/16
2) Redwood: we will send an updated SOW and a redline of the MSA for procurement review (DocuSign link included)

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/req/XYZ-2345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/45123

Thanks — looking forward to the finance packet on 12/17.

Cheers,
Evelyn
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
